<!--
Feature requests that explain the use case get traction; feature requests that just name a solution often don't.
Tell us *what* you want to do and *why* — we'll figure out *how* together.
-->

<!-- What can't you do today that you want to be able to do? What workaround are you using? -->

### Scope

- [ ] Affects one package (which one?)
- [ ] Affects multiple packages
- [ ] Affects the docs site
